description: This file is a frontend web UI for visualizing and browsing database tables and their data, including dynamic loading, table rendering, and user interaction.
external_files: possibly external CSS frameworks (not explicitly referenced in code, but styles are embedded),
external_methods: fetch() (built-in JavaScript API for network requests)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database entry to show associated tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display data in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cells, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long or object data for better readability.
